name: Create, edit and retain a lab asset
description: Verifies authenticated CRUD for a physical device persists after browser refresh.
steps: Sign in to the private LabOS workspace
Open Asset inventory and select Add asset
Create a Workstation titled QA Compute Node with hostname qa-node.lab and VLAN 20
Inspect QA Compute Node, edit its name to QA Compute Node Revised, save and refresh
Return to Asset inventory and inspect the revised device
expected: QA Compute Node Revised remains in the inventory with hostname qa-node.lab and VLAN 20.

name: Map a link between documented devices
description: Verifies network diagram displays manually mapped devices and links.
steps: Sign in and register assets Test Router One and Test Switch Two
Open Network topology and select Add link
Create QA Copper Link from Test Router One to Test Switch Two at 10 GbE
Confirm both devices and their connection appear in the topology and link registry
Open the link inspector
expected: The documented link appears in the topology and shows its speed and two device endpoints.

name: Maintain an experiment and a project
description: Verifies researchers can record experiment methods and project progress.
steps: Sign in and open Experiment notebook
Create an experiment QA PID Controller with objective, procedure and observations
Inspect the experiment and verify its procedure appears
Open Projects & tasks and create QA FPGA Setup with tasks and progress 25
Inspect and edit project progress to 50, then refresh
expected: Experiment notes are visible and QA FPGA Setup retains its tasks and revised progress of 50%.

name: Procurement and telemetry data entry
description: Verifies prospective purchases and manual readings have durable visible outputs.
steps: Sign in and create a documented asset named QA Server
Open Procurement planning and add QA SSD Upgrade with estimated price 220 and target price 180
Confirm the estimated procurement total includes $220
Open Monitoring and record QA Server CPU usage of 42 percent
Confirm recorded CPU is 42%, then use Export and CSV export controls
expected: The purchase appears in procurement, the latest manual reading shows 42% CPU, and export actions provide saved datasets.

name: Validate required input and confirm deletion on mobile
description: Verifies invalid records are rejected and removing an item requires explicit confirmation.
steps: Sign in on a mobile viewport and open Asset inventory
Tap Add asset, leave Asset name empty and submit
Confirm title validation appears, then close editor
Create a device named QA Remove Me and inspect it
Tap Delete, cancel confirmation, then delete again and confirm; refresh
expected: Blank entry is rejected, cancellation leaves the item intact and confirmed deletion removes QA Remove Me persistently.
